evals.prompt: Audit crates/qgis-protocol for code-quality issues. If you find a verified, behavior-preserving refactor, create a focused backlog task for it. Do not change source code.
evals.expected_output: A scoped evidence-based audit with concrete file and line references, relevant refactor and clean-code principles, checks actually run, and a focused backlog task only for validated refactoring work. The task requires the repository's TDD workflow. No source files are changed.
expectations: Reads the refactor and clean-code-principles skills and checks relevant project guidance before concluding.
Reports only evidence-backed findings with concrete locations and a behavior-preserving recommendation.
Searches for an existing backlog item and uses the backlog CLI rather than editing task metadata by hand.
Any created task requires a user-confirmed public seam, a behavior test before implementation, and focused verification per the TDD skill.
Does not modify production source code during the audit.

evals.prompt: Audit the operation registry. The API docs say the registry is the single source of truth, but an integration test expects a different operation list. Figure out which one is wrong and create the refactor task.
evals.expected_output: The audit identifies the conflict, does not decide which contract is authoritative, and uses grill-me to ask a focused clarification question. It pauses task creation until the user answers and makes no source changes.
expectations: Identifies the disagreement between docs and test as a contract ambiguity.
Does not silently privilege the test, docs, or implementation.
Uses grill-me when available, or asks a focused clarification directly and pauses when skill invocation is unavailable.
Does not create a task whose acceptance criteria assume one side of the conflict.

evals.prompt: Please audit crates/qgis-protocol for maintainability and give me a report only. Don't create tickets or change code.
evals.expected_output: A scoped audit report with concrete evidence, relevant principles, and checks actually performed. It respects report-only scope and creates no backlog task or source changes.
expectations: Keeps the scan within crates/qgis-protocol and relevant context needed to verify its findings.
Uses concrete evidence and distinguishes verified findings from suggestions.
Honors the explicit report-only instruction and creates no backlog task.
Does not modify source code or claim unrun checks passed.
